assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. This is a BACKGROUND-ONLY edit of the attached client product photograph, not a new product generation. The client's actual meat must be preserved as faithfully as possible: identical piece count, silhouette, arrangement, muscle grain, fat/marbling patterns, bone structure, color and cuts. Preserve any existing white foam tray or packaging as part of the product; remove only the external backdrop, including white or transparent areas and unwanted glow around it. Replace external backdrop with an elegant matte dark charcoal BLACK SLATE tabletop, subtle natural stone texture, restrained soft top-left lighting and believable soft contact shadow. Match a premium butcher catalog. Square 1:1 composition; keep the ENTIRE original product arrangement, scale it uniformly to fit the central 80% with clean margins, never crop it, never reshape or add pieces. Do not improve/change marbling, do not turn cuts into Wagyu, do not recolor meat. No new garnish, herbs, salt, utensils, hands, labels, text, logos, watermark. Existing packaging stays exactly as shown. Background is opaque dark slate, not transparent.
